questions.question: Amar, Akbar and Anthony together invested Rs 36894. At the end of the year Amar receives Rs 1570, Akbar receives Rs 2355 and Anthony receives Rs 2826 as profit. What was the difference between the investment of Amar and Anthony?
questions.question_hi: एक साथ अमर, अकबर और एंथोनी ने 36894 रुपये निवेश किये। वर्ष के अंत में अमर को 1570 रुपये, अकबर को 2355 रुपये और एंथनी को 2826 रुपये का लाभ प्राप्त होता है। तो, अमर और एंथोनी के निवेश का अंतर कितना है?
questions.solution:
Ratio of their profit = 1570 ∶ 2355 ∶ 2826 = 10 ∶ 15 ∶ 18

Ratio of their investment = 10 ∶ 15 ∶ 18

Difference between the investment of Amar and Anthony = 36894 x (18 - 10)/(10 + 15 + 18)

= 36894 x 8/43 = Rs. 6864

questions.question: The median of 21 observations is 72. Two more observations are made and the values of these are 20 and 76. What is the median of the 23 observations?
questions.question_hi: 21 प्रेक्षणों की माध्यिका 72 है। दो और प्रेक्षण किए जाते हैं और इनके मान 20 और 76 हैं। 23 प्रेक्षणों की माध्यिका क्या है?
questions.solution:
Original observations = 21

Original Median = 72

New observations = 20 and 76

Median position = (21 + 1)/2 = 11th observation

So, 11th observation = 72

20 is smaller than 72, so it will be added before the median.

76 is greater than 72, so it will be added after the median.

Total observations = 23

New Median position = (23 + 1)/2

= 12th observation

The 12th observation remains 72.

questions.solution:
Let male population of Timbuktoo be m1 and male population of Gimbuktoo be m2

Let female population of Timbuktoo be f1 and female population of Gimbuktoo be f2

So (m1 + f1) : (m2 + f2) = 7:9

m1 = f2

f1 : m2 = 2:3

=> 3f1 = 2m2

So (m1 + (2/3)m2):(m2 + m1) = 7:9

9m1 + 6m2 = 7m2 + 7m1

m1:m2 = 1:2

questions.question: If the difference of the mode and median of a data is 26, then what is the difference of the median and mean of the data?

questions.solution:
Empirical relationship =>

Mode = 3 * Median − 2 * Mean

Mode − Median = 26

Now,

(3 * Median − 2 * Mean) − Median = 26

2 * Median - 2 * Mean = 26

Median − Mean = 26/2 = 13

questions.question: An archer targets three different boards in a competition. The probability of hitting the first board is (1/2), the second board is (1/3), and the third board is (1/4). If he shoots once at each board, what is the probability that he hits at least one board?
questions.question_hi: एक तीरंदाज एक प्रतियोगिता में तीन अलग-अलग बोर्डों पर निशाना लगाता है। पहले बोर्ड पर निशाना लगने की प्रायिकता (1/2) है, दूसरे बोर्ड पर (1/3) है, और तीसरे बोर्ड पर (1/4) है। यदि वह प्रत्येक बोर्ड पर एक बार तीर चलाता है, तो इसकी क्या प्रायिकता है कि वह कम से कम एक बोर्ड पर निशाना लगाता है?
questions.solution:
Probability of missing the first board = 1 - (1/2) = 1/2

Probability of missing the second board = 1 - (1/3) = 2/3

Probability of missing the third board = 1 - (1/4) = 3/4

Probability of missing all three boards = (1/2) * (2/3) * (3/4) = 1/4

P(hitting at least one board) = 1 − P(missing all three boards)

= 1 - (1/4)

= 3/4

Hence, the correct answer is Option (b).

questions.question: In a two-candidate election, 12% of voters did not turn up to vote and 40 votes were declared invalid. The winner was supported by 60% of all voters in the list and defeated his opponent by 200 votes. How many voters were on the list?

Votes cast = 88% of x

= 0.88x

Opponent's votes = 0.88x − 40 − 0.60x

0.32x + 40 = 200

0.32x = 160

x = 500

The total number of voters is 500

questions.question: Ritika alone can paint (4/5)th part of a house in 48 hours while Ravi can paint 1/3rd part of the house in 25 hours. If Ravi start painting the house and on every third hour Ritika joined him, then the house will be painted in -
questions.question_hi: रितिका अकेले एक घर के (4/5)वें भाग को 48 घंटे में पेंट कर सकती है, जबकि रवि घर के 1/3वें भाग को 25 घंटे में पेंट कर सकता है। यदि रवि घर को पेंट करना शुरू करता है और प्रत्येक तीसरे घंटे में रितिका उसके साथ जुड़ जाती है, तो घर कितने समय में पेंट हो जाएगा?
questions.solution:
Time taken by Ritika alone to paint = 48 * 5/4 = 60 hours

Time taken by Ravi alone to paint = 25 * 3/1 = 75 hours

Since, Ravi start painting the house and on every third hour Ritika joined him. Then,

First two hours work done by Ravi alone = 2/75

Third hour's work done by Ravi and Ritika together = 1/75 + 1/60 = 3/100

Then, first 3 hours work done = 2/75 + 3/100 = 17/300

Therefore, part of work done in (3 * 17 = 51) hours = 17 * 17/300 = 289/300

Remaining work = 1 - 289/300 = 11/300

Now, part of work done by Ravi in next two hours (i.e., 52nd and 53rd hour) = 2/75

Then, remaining work = 11/300 - 2/75 = 1/100

Now, time taken by Ravi and Ritika together to do remaining work = (1/100) * 100/3 = 1/3 hours = 1/3 * 60 = 20 minutes

Therefore, total time taken = 51 hours + 2 hours + 20 minutes

= 53 hours 20 minutes

questions.question: A shopkeeper earns a profit of 15% if he mixes 85 kg of A-type cement with 35 kg of B-type cement and sells the mixture at Rs. 46 per kg. questions.solution:
"

Formula Used:

Cost price = (Selling price × 100)/(100 + profit%)

Calculation:

Let the cost price of A-type cement be Rs. ‘x’ per kg and that of B-type cement be Rs. ‘y’ per kg

Considering mixture of 85 kg A-type cement with 35 kg B-type cement,

Total quantity of mixture = 85 + 35 = 120 kg

Cost price per kg = (85x + 35y)/120

Cost price per kg = 4600/115 = Rs. 40

85x + 35y = 4800  ----(1)

Similarly,

Considering mixture of 65 kg A-type cement with 35 kg B-type cement,

Total quantity of mixture = 65 + 35 = 100 kg

Cost price per kg = (65x + 35y)/100 = 4650/125 = Rs. 37.2

65x + 35y = 3720  ----(2)

Subtracting (2) from (1), we get,

85x + 35y - 65x - 35y = 4800 - 3720

20x = 1080

x = 1080/20 = Rs. 54

Substituting in (1),

y = (4800 - 4590)/35 = Rs. 6

Now,

If he makes a mixture of 30 kg A-type cement with 50 kg B-type cement,

Total quantity of mixture = 30 + 50 = 80 kg

Cost price per kg = [(30 × 54) + (50 × 6)]/80 = 1920/80 = Rs. 24

In order to earn 75% profit, selling price per kg = 175% of 24 = Rs. 42

First 18 natural numbers = 1, 2, 3, 4, ... 18

Number of observations = 18

For the first n natural numbers, variance = (n2 − 1)/12

Variance = (182 − 1)/12

= (324 − 1)/12

= 323/12

Standard deviation = √26.9167 = 5.19

Volume of a cylinder is proportional to r2h.

New volume / Original volume

Based on the following statements, which is the correct conclusion drawn?

Most of the Citizens from India votes for election and are called as voters. Only few voters are candidates in the elections. It is not true that no candidate is clean.

"Most" and "few" are used with same meaning as that of "some".

Some citizens are voters. Some voters are candidates.

"It is not true that no candidate is clean".

"All voters are clean" is also incorrect. (Note: both these statements affirmatives i.e. both are definite statements and should never be used as "one of the multiple possibilities". i.e. these statements should hold follow in all possible cases)

ऐतिहासिक किलों में व्यावसायिक फिल्मों की शूटिंग से क्षेत्र को बढ़ावा मिल सकता है और स्थानीय लोगों के लिए रोजगार के अवसर पैदा हो सकते हैं। हालाँकि, कुछ स्थानों पर भारी उपकरणों की आवाजाही के कारण पुराने पत्थरों पर खरोंचें आई हैं और पर्यटकों के आने-जाने के रास्तों में बाधा उत्पन्न हुई है। अधिकारी सख्त दिशा-निर्देश लागू करने पर चर्चा कर रहे हैं, लेकिन अभी तक कोई प्रतिबंध या शुल्क लागू नहीं किया गया है।

Three field surveys were conducted in Mysuru, Hubballi, and Belagavi on 6th, 8th, and 10th June.

• The survey in Hubballi was held earlier than the survey in Mysuru.

• Mysuru was not scheduled on 8th June.

• Belagavi was not scheduled on the earliest date.

When was the survey in Belagavi conducted?

- मैसूरु में सर्वेक्षण 8 जून को निर्धारित नहीं था।

- बेलगावी में सर्वेक्षण सबसे शुरुआती तारीख को निर्धारित नहीं था।

बेलगावी में सर्वेक्षण कब आयोजित किया गया था?

Hubballi was earlier than Mysuru.

questions.question: Which of the following correctly identifies the tense used predominantly in the passage?

Option (a): Incorrect. This tense (had been + verb-ing) describes an action that was ongoing for a period of time before another action in the past. (e.g., "He had been training for months before the contest began.") This tense is not used in the passage at all.

Option (b): Correct. This tense describes completed actions in the past. It is the most common tense for telling stories and narrating a sequence of past events.

This tense is used for the vast majority of the actions described, making it the predominant tense.

His face was a Picasso of cherry filling and whipped cream. As the seconds ticked away, it became clear that Uncle Joe was neck-and-neck with a determined teenager. The crowd's cheers reached a fever pitch. In a final, heroic effort, Uncle Joe managed to shovel the last bits of pie into his mouth, narrowly edging out the teenager. Uncle Joe was crowned the Pie-Eating Champion to thunderous applause. With a belly full of cherry pie and a goofy grin on his face, he accepted his prize - a giant pie-shaped trophy that made the whole park burst into laughter.
questions.question: 'Uncle Joe was crowned the Pie-Eating Champion to thunderous applause', the word 'thunderous' here means:
questions.solution: The word 'thunderous' in the sentence means sonorous. In the given context, 'thunderous applause' indicates that the applause for Uncle Joe was loud and resounding, much like the sound of thunder, which is a powerful and booming noise. "Sonorous" (which also means "having a pleasant, deep and full sound") is a synonym for "thunderous" (loud and resonant). Hence, (a) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
A sentence is provided in indirect speech. From the four given options, choose the one that most accurately conveys the sentence in its corresponding direct speech.

The navigator apologised to the harbour master for having ignored the revised signal.

options.label: A
options.text: The navigator said to the harbour master, "I regret that the revised signal had been ignored."

options.label: B
options.text: The navigator said to the harbour master, "I am sorry that I ignored the revised signal."

options.label: C
options.text: The navigator said to the harbour master, "I was sorry that I had ignored the revised signal."

options.label: D
options.text: The navigator said to the harbour master, "Please forgive the revised signal that I ignored."

questions.correct_text: The navigator said to the harbour master, "I am sorry that I ignored the revised signal."
questions.solution:
Option (b) is correct because I AM SORRY THAT I IGNORED THE REVISED SIGNAL directly expresses the navigator's apology for his own completed action. The first-person pronoun "I" identifies the navigator as the person responsible for ignoring the signal, while "I am sorry" appropriately conveys the apology.

Rule: Expressions such as "I am sorry" may be reported using "apologised", with the reason for the apology expressed appropriately in the reported clause.

Rule-based deduction: The navigator is apologising for his own action → use "I am sorry"; the completed action is expressed as "I ignored the revised signal."

 Option (a): The passive construction does not clearly accept personal responsibility for ignoring the signal.

 Option (c): "Was sorry" presents the apology as a past state rather than naturally reproducing the original words.

 Option (d): It incorrectly asks the harbour master to forgive the signal instead of the navigator.

questions.question:
A sentence is provided in direct speech. From the four given options, choose the one that most accurately conveys the sentence in its corresponding indirect speech.

The contractor said to the supplier, "If you disclose these specifications, I will terminate our agreement immediately."

options.label: A
options.text: The contractor warned the supplier not to disclose those specifications because their agreement would be terminated immediately.

options.label: B
options.text: The contractor threatened the supplier that he would terminate their agreement immediately if the supplier disclosed those specifications.

options.label: C
options.text: The contractor threatened to terminate their agreement immediately if the supplier disclosed those specifications.

options.label: D
options.text: The contractor informed the supplier that their agreement had been terminated because those specifications were disclosed.

questions.correct_text: The contractor threatened to terminate their agreement immediately if the supplier disclosed those specifications.
questions.solution:
Option (c) correctly reports the intended threat through THREATENED TO TERMINATE. "These specifications" changes to "those specifications", while the condition remains appropriately expressed.

Rule-based deduction: A threat concerning an action the speaker intends to perform commonly changes to "threatened to + verb".

 Option (a) reports the sentence mainly as a warning and changes the active threat into a passive consequence.

 Option (b) uses the less appropriate structure "threatened the supplier that".

 Option (d) changes a future threat into a completed past event.

questions.question:
A mountaineering company advertised an expedition before obtaining permits, appointing guides or confirming whether the route would remain open.

Logistics Officer: The promotional campaign has already begun, although none of the operational arrangements is complete.

Director: I admit that we may have put the cart before the horse.

What does the Director acknowledge?

options.label: A
options.text: They have acted in the wrong sequence by promoting the expedition too early

options.label: B
options.text: They have selected publicity methods unsuitable for an adventure company

options.label: C
options.text: They have allowed minor arrangements to obstruct the principal objective

options.label: D
options.text: They have invested heavily in preparations that may never be required

questions.correct_text: They have acted in the wrong sequence by promoting the expedition too early
questions.solution:
The Director acknowledges that the company has ACTED IN THE WRONG SEQUENCE BY PROMOTING THE EXPEDITION TOO EARLY. Publicity should have followed the securing of permits, guides and route confirmation. "Put the cart before the horse" means to do things in an illogical or reversed order.

Rule-based deduction: Identify which action should logically have occurred first; the idiom applies when a later-stage action is performed before essential preliminary steps.

Option (b): The problem concerns timing, not the suitability of the publicity method.

Option (c): The arrangements are essential prerequisites, not minor obstacles.

Option (d): The context does not state that large sums were spent on preparations.

questions.question:
Select the appropriate idiom for the given blank.

It's very irresponsible to leave the important chores until ____________.
questions.solution: The idiom 'the eleventh hour' (which means 'for the last moment') fits in the sentence contextually as the sentence says that it is not right to leave important tasks for the last moment. Other idioms 'at sea'(which means 'confused and lost'), 'give cold shoulder'(which means 'to ignore') and 'a close shave'(which means 'narrow escape') do not fit contextually in the given sentence. Hence, the answer is option b).

questions.question:
Select the most suitable meaning of the idiom used in the sentence.

The committee's glowing remarks about transparency rang hollow after it refused to publish the evaluation scores.
questions.solution:
The idiom RANG HOLLOW means to sound false, empty, or unconvincing. The committee praises transparency but refuses to release scores, so option (3) is correct.

• option (a): This is incorrect because the refusal weakens the remarks rather than supporting them.

• option (b): This is incorrect because the issue is sincerity, not formality.

• option (d): This is incorrect because nothing becomes legally binding.

Rule-based deduction: When words conflict with actions, this idiom indicates that the statement lacks sincerity or credibility.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an INCORRECTLY spelt word.

The chef prepared an excuisite feast, skilfully/ combining rare ingredients to create a culinary masterpiece/ that delighted the senses and left the guests in/ awe of his unparalleled artistry.

options.label: A
options.text: The chef prepared an excuisite feast, skilfully

options.label: B
options.text: combining rare ingredients to create a culinary masterpiece

options.label: C
options.text: that delighted the senses and left the guests in

options.label: D
options.text: awe of his unparalleled culinary artistry

questions.correct_text: The chef prepared an excuisite feast, skilfully
questions.solution:
The segment that contains an incorrectly spelled word is: The chef prepared an excuisite feast, skilfully. The correct spelling of the word should be "exquisite," not "excuisite."

Exquisite - extremely beautiful or admirable.

Hence, (a) is the correct answer.

questions.question: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word "MITIGATE".
questions.solution:
INTENSIFY is correct because to mitigate a difficulty, penalty, pain, or harmful effect is to make it less severe, whereas to intensify something is to make it stronger or more severe.

• Option (a) INTENSIFY reverses the direction of meaning and is the correct antonym.

• Option (b) MODERATE can mean to reduce the intensity of something and is therefore close to mitigate.

• Option (c) ALLEVIATE means to make suffering or difficulty less severe and is a synonym.

• Option (d) TEMPER can mean to soften or moderate an effect, so it also moves in the same semantic direction as mitigate.

Rule-based deduction: For directional verbs, determine whether the action increases or decreases a condition. MITIGATE decreases severity; INTENSIFY increases it.

questions.question:
Change the following from active to passive:

While the hearing was in progress, the defence counsel was cross-examining the witness whom the prosecution had recalled.

options.label: A
options.text: While the hearing was in progress, the witness whom the prosecution had recalled had been cross-examined by the defence counsel.

options.label: B
options.text: While the hearing was in progress, the witness whom the prosecution had recalled was being cross-examined by the defence counsel.

options.label: C
options.text: While the hearing was in progress, the witness whom the prosecution had recalled was cross-examined by the defence counsel.

options.label: D
options.text: While the hearing was in progress, the witness whom the prosecution had recalled was being cross-examine by the defence counsel.

questions.correct_text: While the hearing was in progress, the witness whom the prosecution had recalled was being cross-examined by the defence counsel.
questions.solution:
Option (b) is correct. The active verb "was cross-examining" is in the past continuous. Its passive form is WAS BEING CROSS-EXAMINED, while the embedded clause "whom the prosecution had recalled" remains unchanged.

Option (a) changes the main action to the past perfect.

Option (c) changes the continuing action to the simple past.

Option (d) incorrectly uses "cross-examine" instead of the past participle "cross-examined."

Rule: Active structure: Subject + was/were + V-ing + object àPassive structure: Object + was/were + being + V3 + by + subject

questions.question:
Some sentences are given below. While the first and the last sentences (I and II) are in the correct order, the sentences in between are jumbled up. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

I. In the heart of the enchanted forest, a mysterious aura hung in the air, captivating all who entered.

A. Sunlight filtered through the lush canopy, casting a gentle glow on the vibrant flora below.

B. Birds of exotic plumage darted through the branches, their melodic songs adding to the enchantment.

C. Ancient trees, with gnarled trunks and intricate root systems, seemed to whisper secrets of forgotten times.

D. The forest floor was carpeted with a tapestry of wildflowers in a breathtaking array of colours.

II. As one ventured deeper, the magic of the forest became an irresistible embrace.
questions.solution: A provides a description of the lighting within the forest, creating an image of the environment. Further, the presence of exotic birds and their songs contributes to the magical and enchanting atmosphere of the forest in sentence B. D complements the earlier descriptions by adding details about the colourful wildflowers on the forest floor. The sentence about the ancient trees fits well after D, as it continues the description of the forest environment and adds an element of mystery and history. Overall, the sequence ABDC creates a coherent paragraph. Hence, (d) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
In the question given below, a set of four sentences is given, which when properly sequenced, form a coherent paragraph. Arrange the sentences in correct order and mark the correct order as your answer.

A. But many returned goods don't find their way back on shelves, instead, they wind up at stores like the Treasure Hunt Bin Megastore - where liquidated pallets of returned goods get unloaded every Thursday and sold throughout the week.

B. Return policies have been around at least since Sears started offering customers a "money-back guarantee" over 100 years ago.

C. But the right to return has also opened up Pandora's box for retailers and as online shopping has grown, so have returns.

D. Since then, generous return policies have become the norm and customers have come to expect the option to send back the things they buy.
questions.solution:
The use of '100 years ago' in B and the use of 'Since' in the staring of D makes us realize that B is followed by D. B tells us that return policies have existed at least since Sears began giving a money-back guarantee to consumers over a century ago. D tells us that since then, robust return policies have been the standard, and customers have learned to anticipate the ability to return anything they purchase. Thereafter, C carries forward the information by stating that the freedom to return has opened Pandora's box for businesses, and returns have increased in tandem with internet buying. A is the concluding sentence as it tells us that many returned products, however, don't make it back to the shelves; instead, they end up in places like the Treasure Hunt Bin Megastore, where liquidated pallets of returned goods are unloaded every Thursday and sold all week.

Therefore, the correct answer is: (d) BDCA.

questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. The reasons for the dwindling stock are numerous, according to food industry analysts, and include some issues that impacted retailers at the beginning of the pandemic as well as challenges that have cropped up more recently.

B. "We're really seeing the perfect storm," Phil Lempert, editor of the website SupermarketGuru.com, told NPR regarding the food shortages.

C. Social media is rife with images of empty supermarket aisles and signs explaining the lack of available food and other items.

D. Stores such as Aldi have apologized to customers for the shortages when those pictures went viral.
questions.solution:
If we read the sentences carefully, we can easily comprehend that C is the introductory sentence as it tells us that there are pictures of deserted grocery aisles and placards describing the dearth of accessible food and other products on social media. Then, D tells us further that for the shortage of goods, stores like Aldi apologized to the customers when those pictures, mentioned in C, went viral. Then A tells us more about the reason for the food shortages. It explains that according to food industry professionals, the reasons for the shrinking supply include certain difficulties that hampered merchants during the start of the pandemic as well as challenges that have arisen more recently. B is the concluding sentence where Phil Lempert shares that they are truly encountering the perfect storm, regarding the food shortages.

Therefore, the correct answer is: (c) CDAB.

questions.question:
Some sentences are given below. While the first and the last sentences (S1 and S6) are in the correct order, the four sentences in between are jumbled up. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

S1. The Great Wildebeest Migration in East Africa is one of the most awe-inspiring natural spectacles on the planet, involving over a million animals.

A. This relentless journey is fraught with peril, as predators such as lions, cheetahs, and hyenas stalk the herds on land.

B. Driven by the seasonal rains, these vast herds of wildebeest, along with zebras and gazelles, travel in a clockwise loop through the Serengeti and Maasai Mara ecosystems.

C. The most dramatic obstacle, however, is the crossing of the Mara and Grumeti rivers, where giant crocodiles lie in wait for the exhausted animals.

D. Their primary motivation for this colossal trek is the constant search for fresh grazing lands and better-quality water.

S6. This epic cycle of life and death is a crucial engine for the entire ecosystem, shaping the landscape and sustaining its diverse predator populations.
questions.solution:
S1 introduces the Great Wildebeest Migration. Sentence B provides essential context, explaining what drives the migration ("seasonal rains") and the path "these vast herds" take. Sentence D builds on this by stating their "primary motivation" for "this colossal trek," which is the search for food and water. Sentence A then introduces the dangers of "This relentless journey," mentioning the land-based predators. Sentence C introduces an even greater danger with the transition "The most dramatic obstacle, however," describing the river crossings. The sequence BDAC logically describes the migration by explaining its cause and path, its motivation, the general dangers, and finally, the most specific and dramatic danger, leading to the conclusion in S6.

Hence, option (a) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option for the given blank.

Of all the rebuttals offered during the hearing, the chairperson found Vikram's explanation by far the ______ in separating fact from speculation.
questions.solution:
Option (d) is correct because the sentence compares Vikram's explanation with all the rebuttals in the group, and the phrase "by far the" strengthens a superlative. MOST CONVINCING is therefore the correct form. Rule: when one item stands above all others in a group, use the superlative, especially after phrases like "by far the."

• Option (a): MORE CONVINCING is comparative, which is used mainly for a two-way comparison.

• Option (b): AS CONVINCING indicates equality, which does not match the meaning here.

• Option (c): THE MORE CONVINCING is not the correct form in this superlative context.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank(s).

The celebrated _____ released his highly anticipated novel, _____ readers worldwide.
questions.solution:
Since the person is celebrated and the readers were expecting the novel to be out soon, 'repelling' doesn't align well with the given context. So, option (b) is eliminated. The word in the second blank conveys the effect on the readers. The word 'declaring' doesn't fit in the sentence. So, option (d) is eliminated. The word 'astonished' is an adjective and -ed verb. We cannot use it in the second position as an -ing verb is required to express the present scenario.

Among the given options, option (a) contains the correct combination of words. The word 'captivating' means 'holding your attention by being extremely interesting, exciting, pleasant, or attractive'.

Hence, option (a) is the correct answer.

The complete sentence is: The celebrated author released his highly anticipated novel, captivating readers worldwide.

questions.question:
Change the following from active to passive:

Who has authorised the temporary closure of the eastern gallery?

options.label: B

options.label: C

options.label: D

questions.correct_text: By whom has the temporary closure of the eastern gallery been authorised?
questions.solution:
Option (a) is correct because BY WHOM HAS .. BEEN AUTHORISED preserves the present-perfect tense and correctly changes the active interrogative beginning with "who."

Option (b) changes the tense to the simple past.

Option (c) uses "who" where formal passive construction requires "whom."

Option (d) changes the tense to the past perfect.

Rule: When "who" is the doer in an active question, the formal passive form begins with "By whom."

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate tense form to replace the bold word/phrase.

If only the curator preserved the original seal before allowing the manuscript to be handled by visitors.
questions.solution:
The correct phrase is HAD PRESERVED because "If only" expresses regret about something that did not happen in the past. For past regret, past perfect is used.

• Option (a) states a present habit or general fact, which does not express regret.

• Option (b) links the action to the present, but the sentence refers to a missed past action.

• Option (d) refers to a future action, which cannot correct the past mistake.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate tense form to replace the bold word/phrase.

The geologists were mapping the escarpment for three weeks before the first tremor forced them to abandon the survey.
questions.solution:
The correct phrase is HAD BEEN MAPPING because the mapping continued for a duration before another past event, the tremor. Past perfect continuous is used for an ongoing action that lasted up to a later point in the past.

• Option (a) connects the action to the present, but the sentence is about two past events.

• Option (c) refers to completion before a future point, which is not the context here.

• Option (d) shows a present ongoing action, while the tremor and abandonment are past events.

• Select the most appropriate tense form to replace the bold word/phrase.

questions.question:
Fill in the blank with the appropriate article.

After nearly six hours of cross-examination, the arbitrator allowed the witness _____ hour-long adjournment.
questions.solution:
AN is correct because the "h" in "hour" is silent, so "hour-long" begins with a vowel sound. The adjournment is also being introduced for the first time. Rule: The choice between "a" and "an" depends on pronunciation, not spelling.

Option (a): THE would refer to a previously specified adjournment.

Option (c): A cannot precede the vowel sound with which "hour" begins.

Option (d): "Adjournment" is a singular countable noun and requires a determiner.

questions.question: Select the sentence in which the '-ing' form of verb expresses the continuity of an action/event.

options.label: A
options.text: He was preparing for the interview while listening to motivational podcasts.

options.label: B
options.text: The boiling water created a soothing sound in the kitchen.

options.label: C
options.text: They considered applying for new jobs in the coming months.

options.label: D
options.text: I love listening to music while traveling on long trips.

questions.correct_text: He was preparing for the interview while listening to motivational podcasts.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: a) He was preparing for the interview while listening to motivational podcasts.

In this sentence, "was preparing" is a past continuous verb phrase, and "preparing" is the "-ing" form showing that the action was ongoing at a particular moment in the past. It clearly expresses the continuity of an action.

In option b), "boiling" functions as a participial adjective describing the water, not indicating an ongoing event in grammatical terms.

Option c) uses "applying" as a gerund, functioning as the object of "considered," not showing continuity.

Option d) uses "listening" and "traveling" as gerunds that describe general preferences or habits, not actions in progress at a specific moment.

Therefore, only option a) uses the "-ing" form to indicate the continuity of an action or event.

Note: Gerund: Gerund is a verb form that functions as a noun, ending in -ing. A gerund can be either the subject or object of a sentence in English. Example: "Everybody enjoyed her dancing and singing at the party." The words 'dancing' and 'singing' are gerunds.

Participle: A word formed from a verb (e.g. going, gone, being, been) and used as an adjective (e.g. working woman, burnt toast) or a noun (e.g. good breeding). In English, participles are also used to make compound verb forms (e.g. is going, has been). Consider the sentences given below:

Dancing at the party, the women fell on the ground.

Encouraged by her parents, Rita went on to pursue her passion.

The highlighted word in the first sentence is of the form Verb + ing and is used as a present participle. It is used to denote an action that is going on or incomplete or imperfect.

The highlighted word in the second sentence is of the form verb + ed. It is used as a past participle. It denotes the completed action or state of the thing spoken of.

A past participle ends with the following: -ed, -d, -t, -en, or -n.

One should take great care and never get confused between a gerund and a present participle. They use the same forms but perform different functions: a gerund is a verbal noun, while a present participle is a verbal adjective.

questions.question:
Parts of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

Abid has recently bought really expensive sunglass from a fancy showroom.
questions.solution:
In the given sentence, the catch is the usage of the singular form of the noun 'sunglasses', which is incorrect. Some nouns are always used in plural forms; 'sunglasses' is one such word. Hence, (c) is the correct answer.

The final sentence would be: Abid has recently bought really expensive sunglasses from a fancy showroom.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: GNOMON
questions.solution:
A GNOMON is the projecting part of a sundial whose shadow indicates the time. POINTER is the most appropriate synonym because the gnomon functions as the indicating element of the instrument.

Rule-based deduction: The correct option must describe an indicating component rather than an object associated with motion, rotation or vertical measurement.

Option (a): A pendulum is a suspended weight that swings regularly.

Option (b): A spindle is a rotating rod or shaft used in machinery or spinning.

Option (d): A plummet is a weight used to determine vertical alignment or depth.

questions.question: Which sentence uses "fallen" correctly?

options.label: A
options.text: During the night, several branches had fallen across the garden path.

options.label: B
options.text: The sudden storm fallen several weak trees near the road.

options.label: C
options.text: The workers had fallen the damaged tree before traffic resumed.

options.label: D
options.text: The price of vegetables fallen sharply after the new crop arrived.

questions.correct_text: During the night, several branches had fallen across the garden path.
questions.solution:
Option (a) is correct because FALLEN is the past participle of "fall" and correctly follows "had." The branches came down by themselves.

• Option (b): "Felled" is required when something causes trees to fall.

• Option (c): "Felled" is required because the workers deliberately cut the tree down.

• Option (d): "Fell" is required in the simple past.

Rule: Fall - fell - FALLEN. "Fell" can also be a verb meaning to cut or knock something down.

questions.question: Which sentence uses "ridden" correctly?

options.label: A
options.text: Before moving to the city, she had never ridden a bicycle on a busy road.

options.label: B
options.text: He ridden his horse through the field early yesterday morning.

options.label: C
options.text: The children were ridden their bicycles when the rain began.

options.label: D
options.text: Maya has rode this route many times during the summer.

questions.correct_text: Before moving to the city, she had never ridden a bicycle on a busy road.
questions.solution:
Option (a) is correct because RIDDEN is the past participle of "ride" and correctly follows "had."

• Option (b): "Rode" is required for a completed simple-past action.

• Option (c): "Riding" is required after "were" to form the past continuous.

• Option (d): "Ridden" must follow "has."

Rule: Ride - rode - RIDDEN.

questions.passage:
Directions : Read the following passage and answer the questions based on the passage:

"Charity expects no applause" is a powerful reminder that true kindness loses its purity the moment it begins seeking attention, recognition, or public validation. In earlier times, people were taught to help others quietly and move on without constantly speaking about their generosity. The beauty of a good deed lay in its sincerity rather than its visibility. However, in today's social media-driven world, kindness is increasingly becoming performative. Videos of feeding the poor, helping homeless individuals, distributing food, or feeding stray animals are often recorded with cameras carefully positioned to capture every emotional reaction. While the help being provided may still benefit someone, the intention behind publicising every act often raises an important question: is the focus truly on compassion, or on being seen as compassionate? Not everything meaningful needs to be documented. Some moments lose their depth the moment they are converted into online content for likes, shares, and instant appreciation. When every act of kindness becomes a public performance, goodness slowly starts turning into a form of social currency. Instead of experiencing inner fulfilment, people begin depending on external validation to feel satisfied about their actions. In such situations, the emotional essence of helping can quietly fade away. The younger generation especially needs to understand the importance of boundaries in the digital age. Social media should not become a place where every personal emotion, charitable act, or meaningful interaction is displayed for publicity. Certain acts carry more dignity when they remain private. Quiet kindness often leaves a deeper impact than loudly advertised generosity. People must also learn to stop seeking immediate applause for every good thing they do. The universe has its own way of returning kindness, often unexpectedly and in much greater forms than temporary online praise. Not every good deed requires an audience. Sometimes, helping someone silently and walking away with a peaceful heart is far more meaningful than receiving thousands of views on a screen. Genuine compassion does not ask to be seen; it simply exists because humanity still exists within the human heart.
questions.question: Which of the following analogies best reflects the central idea of the passage?

options.label: A
options.text: A tree gives shade quietly without demanding recognition in return

options.label: B
options.text: A teacher repeats lessons loudly to ensure every student understands them

options.label: C
options.text: A traveller documents every journey in order to preserve memories carefully

options.label: D
options.text: A musician performs publicly because art becomes meaningful only through applause

questions.correct_text: A tree gives shade quietly without demanding recognition in return
questions.solution: Among the given options, (a) is the best fit because the passage emphasises that genuine kindness should exist quietly without seeking attention or praise. The analogy of a tree giving shade silently reflects selfless service without expectation of recognition. Hence, (a) is the correct answer. Option (b) is incorrect because it focuses on instruction rather than silent generosity. Option (c) is incorrect as documentation is not the central idea being praised. Option (d) is incorrect because the passage criticises actions motivated by applause and validation.

The God of Small Things by Arundhati Roy won the Booker Prize in 1997.

Consider the following statements regarding the Industrial Policy Resolution (IPR), 1956:

i. The IPR 1956 classified industries into three schedules, with Schedule A industries placed under the exclusive responsibility of the State for future development, subject to specified exceptions.

ii. The IPR 1956 was formulated in line with the goal of a 'socialistic pattern of society', adopted by the Indian National Congress at its Avadi session in 1955.

iii. The IPR 1956 completely prohibited private sector participation in industries listed under Schedule A, permitting no exceptions whatsoever.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
औद्योगिक नीति संकल्प (IPR), 1956 के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i. IPR 1956 ने उद्योगों को तीन अनुसूचियों में वर्गीकृत किया, जिसमें अनुसूची A के उद्योगों को निर्दिष्ट अपवादों के अधीन, भविष्य के विकास के लिए राज्य के अनन्य उत्तरदायित्व के तहत रखा गया।

ii. IPR 1956 को 1955 में अपने अवाडी सत्र में भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस द्वारा अपनाए गए 'समाज के समाजवादी स्वरूप' के लक्ष्य के अनुरूप तैयार किया गया था।

iii. IPR 1956 ने अनुसूची A के तहत सूचीबद्ध उद्योगों में निजी क्षेत्र की भागीदारी को पूरी तरह से प्रतिबंधित कर दिया, जिसमें किसी भी अपवाद की अनुमति नहीं थी।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statements i and ii are correct. The IPR 1956 classified industries into three schedules - Schedule A (17 industries reserved exclusively for the state, such as arms, atomic energy, and railways), Schedule B (12 industries where the state would take the initiative but private enterprise could supplement), and Schedule C (all remaining industries left to the private sector) - in line with the 'socialistic pattern of society' goal adopted at the Congress's Avadi session in 1955.

Statement iii is incorrect: the resolution did not impose an absolute prohibition - Existing private units in most of the non-monopoly Schedule A industries were allowed to continue and expand, while four industries were government monopolies, and the state retained discretion to involve private enterprise in Schedule A industries where national interest required it.

Further Insights:

The IPR 1956 is often referred to as the 'Economic Constitution of India' and remained the guiding framework for industrial policy until the New Economic Policy of 1991 substantially liberalised these restrictions.

questions.question: Which architectural style developed in colonial India blended traditional Indian elements such as jharokhas, chhatris, and onion domes with British structural engineering?
questions.question_hi: औपनिवेशिक भारत में विकसित किस स्थापत्य शैली ने झरोखों, छतरियों और प्याज के गुंबदों जैसे पारंपरिक भारतीय तत्वों को ब्रिटिश संरचनात्मक इंजीनियरिंग के साथ मिश्रित किया?
questions.solution:
Indo-Saracenic architecture developed during British rule by combining Indian and Indo-Islamic architectural features with European structural forms.

It commonly used domes, chhatris, arches, jharokhas and other Indian decorative elements in buildings designed with modern colonial construction methods.

The style became prominent in major public and administrative buildings during the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries.

Further Insights:

- Robert Fellowes Chisholm and Swinton Jacob were important architects associated with the development of the Indo-Saracenic style.

- Indo-Saracenic architecture was frequently used for railway stations, museums, colleges, courts and municipal buildings.

- Domed chhatris, pinnacles, towers and minarets are common decorative features of this architectural style.

- Colonial architecture in India also made extensive use of Neo-Classical and Neo-Gothic styles.

questions.question:
Given below are two statements, one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R):

Assertion (A): The work done by a variable force acting on a body over a finite displacement is evaluated by directly multiplying the arithmetic mean of the initial and final force values with the total displacement.

Reason (R): For a variable force, the total work done corresponds geometrically to the area enclosed under the force-displacement graph over the given displacement interval.

In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:
questions.question_hi:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं, एक को अभिकथन (A) और दूसरे को कारण (R) के रूप में लेबल किया गया है:

अभिकथन (A): एक परिमित विस्थापन पर किसी पिंड पर कार्य करने वाले एक परिवर्ती बल द्वारा किया गया कार्य प्रारंभिक और अंतिम बल मानों के समांतर माध्य को कुल विस्थापन से सीधे गुणा करके मूल्यांकित किया जाता है।

कारण (R): एक परिवर्ती बल के लिए, किया गया कुल कार्य दिए गए विस्थापन अंतराल पर बल-विस्थापन ग्राफ के अंतर्गत संलग्न क्षेत्र के ज्यामितीय रूप से मेल खाता है।

उपरोक्त कथनों के आलोक में, नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सबसे उपयुक्त उत्तर चुनें:

options.label: A
options.text: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
options.text_hi: (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है

options.label: B
options.text: Both (A) and (R) are correct but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
options.text_hi: (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं लेकिन (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है

questions.solution:
Assertion (A) is incorrect:

For a general variable force, work cannot be calculated merely by taking the arithmetic mean of the initial and final force values and multiplying it by displacement.

The work is obtained by integrating the force with respect to displacement over the required interval.

The arithmetic-mean method gives the exact result only in special cases, such as when force varies linearly with displacement.

Reason (R) is correct:

For a variable force acting along the direction of displacement, the work done is represented by the area under the force-displacement graph.

Mathematically, this corresponds to integrating force with respect to displacement over the given interval.

Further insights:

• The SI unit of work is joule (J).

• One joule is equivalent to one newton-metre (N m).

• Work is positive when force acts in the direction of displacement.

• Work is negative when force acts opposite to displacement.

• Spring force is an example of a variable conservative force.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements is/are true about the appointment in the India AI Mission in June 2026?

1. Saurabh Vijay has been appointed as the CEO of the India AI Mission.

2. He replaced Priyank Bharti.

2. Saurabh Vijay has been given the additional charge alongside his role as CEO of UIDAI.
questions.question_hi:
जून 2026 में इंडिया AI मिशन में नियुक्ति के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा/से कथन सत्य है/हैं?

1. सौरभ विजय को इंडिया AI मिशन के CEO के रूप में नियुक्त किया गया है।

2. उन्होंने प्रियंक भारती का स्थान लिया है।

3. सौरभ विजय को UIDAI के CEO के रूप में अपनी भूमिका के साथ-साथ अतिरिक्त प्रभार भी सौंपा गया है।
questions.solution: The Union government has appointed IAS officer Saurabh Vijay as the chief executive officer (CEO) of the India AI Mission, according the ministry of electronics and information technology (MeitY). Vijay, a 1998-batch officer of the Maharashtra cadre, has been given the additional charge alongside his role as CEO of the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI). The post in the India AI Mission had remained vacant since the departure of former CEO Abhishek Singh from MeitY. Meanwhile, the government has appointed 2001-batch IAS officer Priyank Bharti as the chairperson of the Online Gaming Authority. Bharti is also serving as director general of the National Informatics Centre (NIC), a post previously held by Singh.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding national income accounting:

I. Nominal GDP is calculated using the constant prices of a chosen base year.

II. Real GDP measures the total monetary value of final output adjusted for price changes.

III. The GDP deflator reflects the general price change across all domestically produced goods and services.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
राष्ट्रीय आय लेखांकन के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

I. सांकेतिक जीडीपी की गणना एक चुने हुए आधार वर्ष की स्थिर कीमतों का उपयोग करके की जाती है।

II. वास्तविक जीडीपी मूल्य परिवर्तनों के लिए समायोजित अंतिम उत्पादन के कुल मौद्रिक मूल्य को मापता है।

III. जीडीपी अपस्फीतिकारक सभी घरेलू रूप से उत्पादित वस्तुओं और सेवाओं में सामान्य मूल्य परिवर्तन को दर्शाता है।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन से सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement I is incorrect:

Nominal GDP is measured at current prices prevailing in the year of measurement.

GDP at constant prices is used to measure real GDP and removes the effect of price changes.

Therefore, Statement I incorrectly associates constant prices with nominal GDP.

Statement II is correct:

Real GDP measures the value of final goods and services after removing the effect of changes in prices.

It is generally expressed using constant prices so that changes in output can be measured more clearly.

Therefore, Statement II is correct.

Statement III is correct:

The GDP deflator is derived from the relationship between GDP at current prices and GDP at constant prices.

It is a broad measure of price changes covering the goods and services included in domestic GDP.

Therefore, Statement III is correct.

Further insights:

• Current-price GDP is also called nominal GDP.

• Constant-price GDP is also called real GDP.

• The GDP deflator is calculated from current-price and constant-price GDP.

• The GDP deflator is broader in coverage than consumer price measures because it covers domestic GDP production.

• Real GDP is useful for analysing economic growth without the direct effect of price changes.

questions.question: Which of the following statements correctly distinguishes between the relief features of the Northern Plains?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन उत्तरी मैदानों की उच्चावच विशेषताओं के बीच सही ढंग से अंतर करता है?

options.label: A
options.text: Bhabar is a narrow marshy tract formed by streams reappearing south of the outer Himalayan foothills.
options.text_hi: भाबर एक संकीर्ण दलदली भूभाग है जो बाहरी हिमालय की तलहटी के दक्षिण में फिर से प्रकट होने वाली धाराओं द्वारा बनता है।

options.label: B
options.text: Bhangar represents the older alluvial terrace systems situated well above the active floodplains of the river.
options.text_hi: भांगर पुरानी जलोढ़ वेदिका प्रणालियों का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है जो नदी के सक्रिय बाढ़ के मैदानों से काफी ऊपर स्थित हैं।

options.label: C
options.text: Khadar constitutes older alluvium containing calcareous deposits known locally as kankar across higher upland terraces.
options.text_hi: खादर में पुरानी जलोढ़ मिट्टी होती है जिसमें चूनेदार जमाव होते हैं जिन्हें स्थानीय रूप से उच्च ऊपरी वेदिकाओं पर कंकड़ के रूप में जाना जाता है।

options.label: D
options.text: Terai comprises a dry pebble-studded belt parallel to the Shiwaliks where fast river streams completely disappear underground.
options.text_hi: तराई में शिवालिक के समानांतर एक सूखी कंकड़-जड़ित पट्टी शामिल है जहाँ तेज़ नदी की धाराएँ पूरी तरह से भूमिगत हो जाती हैं।

questions.correct_text: Bhangar represents the older alluvial terrace systems situated well above the active floodplains of the river.
questions.solution:
Bhangar is composed of older alluvium and lies above the floodplains of the rivers. It has a terrace-like appearance and contains calcareous deposits known as kankar. Therefore, the description in option (b) correctly identifies Bhangar.

Further Insights:

• Bhabar is generally about 8 - 16 km wide along the Shiwalik slopes.

• Streams disappear in the Bhabar belt because of its coarse deposits.

• Terai lies south of the Bhabar belt.

• The Terai region is characterised by wet and swampy conditions.

questions.question: Which of the following Indian wrestlers won the gold medal in the women's 76kg category at the Ulaanbaatar Open 2026 by defeating Nigeria's Damola Ojo in the final?
questions.question_hi: उलानबटार ओपन 2026 में महिलाओं की 76 किलोग्राम भार वर्ग के फाइनल में नाइजीरिया की डामोला ओजो को हराकर किस भारतीय पहलवान ने स्वर्ण पदक जीता?
questions.solution: Asian Games-bound Sagar Jaglan and teenager Kajal Dhochak clinched golds in their respective categories as India secured six more medals on the third day of the Ulaanbaatar Open 2026 wrestling tournament in Mongolia. The 21-year-old Sagar Jaglan topped the podium in the men s freestyle 74kg category with a 3-2 win over Tamir Eshinimaev in the final. The 22-year-old Jaideep, meanwhile, recovered through repechage to claim the bronze after a 15-4 technical superiority win over Munkhbat in the medal bout. She then defeated Kazakhstan s Elmira Syzdykova by fall in the semi-finals to enter the gold medal match. Asian Games-bound wrestler Priya Malik settled for a bronze medal in the same category after beating Mongolia s Tuvshinjargal Tarav 8-0. Priya had lost 5-1 against Damola Ojo in the semis to enter the bronze medal bout. India s Hansika Lamba also secured bronze in the women s 55kg category after registering a 10-0 technical superiority win over Mongolia s Ariunzaya Odonchimeg. questions.question:
Which of the following statements is/are true about the Bhakti traditions?

1. Saguna Bhakti involves devotion to a deity with attributes and form.

2. Nirguna Bhakti involves devotion to a formless, attributeless divine.

3. Saguna and Nirguna are the two broad types of Bhakti worship.
questions.question_hi:
भक्ति परंपराओं के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा/से कथन सत्य है/हैं?

1. सगुण भक्ति में किसी ऐसे देवता के प्रति भक्ति की जाती है, जिसमें गुण और साकार रूप विद्यमान हों।

2. निर्गुण भक्ति में निराकार और निर्गुण परमात्मा के प्रति भक्ति की जाती है।

3. सगुण और निर्गुण भक्ति उपासना के दो व्यापक प्रकार हैं।
questions.solution:
- Statement 1 is true: Saguna Bhakti focuses on a deity with a particular form and attributes, such as Rama or Krishna.

- Statement 2 is true: Nirguna Bhakti focuses on the formless and attributeless divine.

- Statement 3 is true: Bhakti traditions broadly classify worship into Saguna and Nirguna.

Further insights:

Bhakti means devotion.

Saguna and Nirguna are the two broad forms of Bhakti.

Alvars were devotees of Vishnu; Nayanars were devotees of Shiva.

Kabir is associated with Nirguna Bhakti.

Mirabai is associated with Saguna Bhakti.

The Bhakti movement promoted devotion, equality, and the use of regional languages.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the ordinance-making power of the executive in India:

I. The President derives the power to promulgate ordinances under Article 123 of the Constitution.

II. An ordinance can be promulgated even when both Houses of Parliament are actively in session.

III. An ordinance automatically ceases to operate six weeks after the reassembly of the legislature unless approved earlier.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारत में कार्यपालिका की अध्यादेश बनाने की शक्ति के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

I. राष्ट्रपति को संविधान के अनुच्छेद 123 के तहत अध्यादेश प्रख्यापित करने की शक्ति प्राप्त है।

II. एक अध्यादेश तब भी प्रख्यापित किया जा सकता है जब संसद के दोनों सदन सक्रिय सत्र में हों।

III. एक अध्यादेश विधानमंडल के फिर से इकट्ठा होने के छह सप्ताह बाद स्वतः ही समाप्त हो जाता है जब तक कि इसे पहले अनुमोदित न कर दिया जाए।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement I is correct:

Article 123 of the Constitution empowers the President to promulgate an Ordinance when Parliament is not in session and immediate action is necessary.

Statement II is incorrect:

The President cannot promulgate an Ordinance when both Houses of Parliament are in session. This condition is specifically provided under Article 123(1).

Statement III is correct:

An Ordinance ceases to operate six weeks after the reassembly of Parliament, unless it is approved earlier or ceases through the constitutional process mentioned in Article 123.

Further insights:

- Article 123 deals with the Ordinance-making power of the President.

- Article 213 deals with the Ordinance-making power of the Governor.

- An Ordinance must be laid before both Houses of Parliament.

- The President may withdraw an Ordinance at any time.

- If both Houses are summoned to reassemble on different dates, the six-week period is calculated from the later date.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding biodiversity hotspots in India:

Statement I: India has four biodiversity hotspots: the Himalaya, Indo-Burma, the Western Ghats and Sri Lanka, and Sundaland.

Statement II: The Andaman Islands form part of the Sundaland hotspot, while the Nicobar Islands form part of the Indo-Burma hotspot.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारत में जैव विविधता हॉटस्पॉट के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

कथन I: भारत में चार जैव विविधता हॉटस्पॉट हैं: हिमालय, इंडो-बर्मा, पश्चिमी घाट और श्रीलंका, और सुंदरलैंड।

कथन II: अंडमान द्वीप समूह सुंदरलैंड हॉटस्पॉट का हिस्सा है, जबकि निकोबार द्वीप समूह इंडो-बर्मा हॉटस्पॉट का हिस्सा है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: A
options.text: Both Statements I and II are correct
options.text_hi: कथन I और II दोनों सही हैं

options.label: D
options.text: Neither Statement I nor II is correct
options.text_hi: न तो कथन I और न ही II सही है

questions.solution:
Statement I is correct: These are the four hotspots recognised in India.

Statement II is incorrect: The Nicobar Islands fall in Sundaland. The Andaman group is part of the Indo-Burma hotspot, so the statement is reversed.

Further insights:

A hotspot must have at least 1,500 endemic vascular plant species and must have lost 70% or more of its original habitat. The concept was proposed by Norman Myers, and Conservation International later adopted it.

questions.question:
Arrange the following mountain passes of India in sequence from West to East:

1) Nathu La

2) Zoji La

3) Shipki La

4) Bomdi La
questions.question_hi:
भारत के निम्नलिखित पर्वतीय दर्रों को पश्चिम से पूर्व के क्रम में व्यवस्थित करें:

1) नाथू ला

2) ज़ोजी ला

3) शिपकी ला

4) बोमडी ला
questions.solution:
Locating the passes geographically from West to East:

Zoji La - Located in Ladakh (Westernmost among these).

Shipki La - Located in Himachal Pradesh (Kinnaur district, boundary with Tibet).

Nathu La - Located in Sikkim.

Bomdi La - Located in Arunachal Pradesh (Easternmost among these).

Hence, the correct sequence from West to East is 2 → 3 → 1 → 4.

Further Insights

Zoji La connects Srinagar with Leh.

Shipki La is the pass through which the Sutlej River enters India from Tibet.

Nathu La forms part of an offshoot of the ancient Silk Route.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding major traditional fairs and cultural gatherings in India:

I. The Nagaur Fair of Rajasthan is primarily a religious river confluence fair dedicated solely to ritual holy bathing without any commercial animal trade.

II. The Lavi Fair is an ancient spice trade fair held in the Kullu valley of Himachal Pradesh to commemorate the coronation of local rulers.

III. The Tarnetar Fair of Gujarat is traditionally linked to the legend of Draupadi's Swayamvara and serves as a major social and matrimonial gathering for tribal youth.

IV. The Bali Jatra of Odisha is celebrated on the banks of the Mahanadi river in Cuttack to commemorate the ancient maritime voyages of Sadhabas to Southeast Asian islands.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारत में प्रमुख पारंपरिक मेलों और सांस्कृतिक समारोहों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

I. राजस्थान का नागौर मेला मुख्य रूप से एक धार्मिक नदी संगम मेला है जो बिना किसी व्यावसायिक पशु व्यापार के पूरी तरह से अनुष्ठानिक पवित्र स्नान को समर्पित है。

II. लवी मेला हिमाचल प्रदेश की कुल्लू घाटी में स्थानीय शासकों के राज्याभिषेक के उपलक्ष्य में आयोजित होने वाला एक प्राचीन मसाला व्यापार मेला है。

III. गुजरात का तरणेतर मेला पारंपरिक रूप से द्रौपदी के स्वयंवर की किंवदंती से जुड़ा है और आदिवासी युवाओं के लिए एक प्रमुख सामाजिक और वैवाहिक समारोह के रूप में कार्य करता है。

IV. ओडिशा की बाली जात्रा कटक में महानदी के तट पर दक्षिण पूर्व एशियाई द्वीपों के लिए साधबों (Sadhabas) की प्राचीन समुद्री यात्राओं की याद में मनाई जाती है。

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement I is incorrect.

The Nagaur Fair of Rajasthan is famous primarily as a major cattle fair rather than as a river-confluence bathing fair. Large numbers of cattle, camels and horses are brought to the fair for trading, along with commodities such as spices and handicrafts. Various cultural performances, competitions and traditional activities also form part of the fair.

Statement II is incorrect.

The Lavi Fair is a historic trade fair held at Rampur Bushahr in the Sutlej valley of Himachal Pradesh, not in the Kullu valley. Its historical origin is linked to a trade treaty concluded in 1681 between the former princely state of Rampur and Tibet. Products traditionally traded include woollens, dry fruits, horses and various local goods.

Statement III is correct.

The Tarnetar Fair of Gujarat is traditionally associated with the legend of Draupadi's Swayamvara from the Mahabharata. The fair is particularly known for its colourful folk traditions and as a gathering where young tribal men and women traditionally seek marriage partners. Music, dance, costumes and elaborately decorated umbrellas are prominent attractions.

Statement IV is correct.

Bali Jatra is prominently celebrated at Cuttack and commemorates Odisha's ancient maritime trade with Southeast Asia. It recalls the voyages of Odia seafarers known as Sadhabas, who sailed to regions such as Bali, Java and Sumatra for trade. The tradition is symbolically remembered through Boita Bandana and other celebrations connected with Odisha's maritime heritage.

questions.question: Which traditional folk dance of Haryana is performed exclusively by women at the bridegroom's house after the wedding procession has departed?
questions.question_hi: हरियाणा का कौन सा पारंपरिक लोक नृत्य विशेष रूप से महिलाओं द्वारा दूल्हे के घर पर बारात के चले जाने के बाद किया जाता है?
questions.solution:
Khoria is a traditional folk dance of Haryana performed exclusively by women at the bridegroom's house after the marriage procession has left for the bride's house.

The women perform it during the night while the male members are away with the wedding party.

The dance is associated with marriage customs and expresses wishes for the safe return of the newly married couple.

Option (a):

Dhamal is a male folk dance of Haryana, especially popular in the Gurugram region.

Option (c):

Phag is performed during the Phalgun season and may involve both men and women.

Option (d):

Gugga dance is traditionally performed by male devotees during processions held in honour of Gugga Pir.

Further Insights:

- Khoria is regarded as a collective form incorporating features of the Jhumar dance style.

- Jhumar in Haryana is traditionally performed by women to the beats of instruments such as dholak and thali.

- Loor is another women-oriented folk dance of Haryana performed around the Holi season.

- Ghoomar is particularly popular in the western parts of Haryana and is marked by circular movements.

questions.question: Which of the following schemes, implemented by the Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs (MoHUA), completed six years of providing affordable collateral-free credit, digital inclusion, and social security to street vendors in May 2026?
questions.question_hi: आवास एवं शहरी कार्य मंत्रालय (MoHUA) द्वारा कार्यान्वित निम्नलिखित में से किस योजना ने मई 2026 में रेहड़ी-पटरी वालों को किफायती बिना किसी गारंटी के ऋण, डिजिटल समावेशन और सामाजिक सुरक्षा प्रदान करने के छह वर्ष पूरे किए?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: दीनदयाल अंत्योदय योजना - राष्ट्रीय शहरी आजीविका मिशन (DAY-NULM)

questions.solution:
PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi), the flagship micro-credit scheme of the Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs (MoHUA), has completed six years of empowering street vendors through affordable collateral-free credit, digital inclusion and social security.

Since its launch in June 2020, PM SVANidhi has emerged as a transformative initiative for street vendors which has facilitated access to formal credit and enabling beneficiaries to strengthen and expand their livelihoods. The scheme has also facilitated more than 1.05 crore loan sanctions amounting to over Rs. 17,800 crore, benefiting street vendors across the country.

The Union Minister further informed that more than 1.12 crore collateral-free loans have been sanctioned under the scheme across the country, while over Rs. 17,800 crore has been disbursed to beneficiaries so far.

Referring to the North-Eastern region, Shri Manohar Lal said that more than 2.59 lakh loans have been distributed in the region, through which financial assistance amounting to over Rs. 430 crore has been extended to street vendors.

Speaking specifically about Tripura, the Union Minister stated that more than 9,300 loans have been sanctioned in the state so far and nearly Rs. 15 crore has been disbursed to beneficiaries under the scheme.

Key Achievements of PM SVANidhi

1.05 crore loan sanctions facilitated.

17,800 crore disbursed under the scheme.

34.81 lakh women street vendors empowered.

50 lakh street vendor families socio-economically profiled under SVANidhi Se Samriddhi.

1.52 crore welfare scheme sanctions facilitated under eight Central Government welfare schemes.

questions.question: Whom did Rani Chennamma adopt as the successor to Kittur, triggering British refusal and armed conflict?
questions.question_hi: रानी चेन्नम्मा ने कित्तूर के उत्तराधिकारी के रूप में किसे गोद लिया, जिससे अंग्रेजों ने इनकार कर दिया और सशस्त्र संघर्ष छिड़ गया?
questions.solution:
After the death of her son, Rani Chennamma adopted Shivalingappa and declared him the heir to the throne of Kittur.

The British East India Company refused to recognise the succession and ordered Chennamma to surrender the adopted heir, leading to armed conflict in 1824.

Further insights:

• Rani Chennamma belonged to Kittur in present-day Karnataka.

• The Kittur resistance against the British occurred in 1824.

• The first major battle of the Kittur revolt took place in October 1824.

• British political agent St. John Thackeray was killed during the first battle.

• Rani Chennamma was eventually captured and imprisoned at Bailhongal Fort.

• Sangolli Rayanna continued resistance against British authority after Chennamma's defeat.

questions.question: In which athletic track event did Kamaljeet Sandhu secure India's first-ever individual female gold medal at the Asian Games?
questions.question_hi: कमलजीत संधू ने एशियाई खेलों में किस एथलेटिक ट्रैक स्पर्धा में भारत का पहला व्यक्तिगत महिला स्वर्ण पदक हासिल किया?

options.label: A
options.text: She won the gold medal in the women's 100-meter individual sprint event.
options.text_hi: उन्होंने महिलाओं की 100 मीटर व्यक्तिगत स्प्रिंट स्पर्धा में स्वर्ण पदक जीता।

options.label: B
options.text: She finished first in the women's 200-meter dash during the continental games.
options.text_hi: उन्होंने महाद्वीपीय खेलों के दौरान महिलाओं की 200 मीटर दौड़ में पहला स्थान हासिल किया।

options.label: C
options.text: She clinched the top podium position in the women's 800-meter track discipline.
options.text_hi: उन्होंने महिलाओं की 800 मीटर ट्रैक स्पर्धा में शीर्ष पोडियम स्थान हासिल किया।

options.label: D
options.text: She secured first place in the women's 400-meter individual running competition.
options.text_hi: उन्होंने महिलाओं की 400 मीटर व्यक्तिगत दौड़ प्रतियोगिता में पहला स्थान हासिल किया।

questions.correct_text: She secured first place in the women's 400-meter individual running competition.
questions.solution:
Kamaljeet Sandhu won the gold medal in the women's 400 metres at the 1970 Asian Games held in Bangkok.

Her victory made her the first Indian woman to win an individual gold medal at the Asian Games.

Therefore, the women's 400-metre event is the correct answer.

Further Insights:

- The 1970 Asian Games were held in Bangkok, Thailand, from 9 to 20 December.

- India won 25 medals at the 1970 Asian Games, including six gold medals.

- India finished fifth in the overall medal standings at the 1970 Asian Games.

- Other Indian athletics gold medallists in 1970 included Joginder Singh, Praveen Kumar and Mohinder Singh Gill.

- P. T. Usha later won gold medals in the women's 200m, 400m and 400m hurdles at the 1986 Asian Games.

questions.question: Which of the following pairs of Rigvedic deities and their primary associations is incorrectly matched?
questions.question_hi: ऋग्वैदिक देवताओं और उनके प्राथमिक संबंधों के निम्नलिखित युग्मों में से कौन सा गलत सुमेलित है?

options.label: A
options.text: Varuna  -  Guardian of Rta and cosmic order
options.text_hi: वरुण - ऋत और ब्रह्मांडीय व्यवस्था के संरक्षक

options.label: B
options.text: Soma  -  Sacred ritual substance and ninth Mandala

options.label: C

questions.correct_text: Ushas  -  Storm forces and atmospheric turbulence
questions.solution:
Ushas is the Rigvedic goddess associated with dawn and the arrival of daylight, not storm forces or atmospheric turbulence.

Storm and atmospheric phenomena are associated more closely with deities such as Rudra and the Maruts.

Further insights:

• Agni is one of the most frequently invoked deities in the Rigveda.

• Indra is strongly associated with warfare, rain and the defeat of Vritra.

• The Maruts are associated with storms and fierce atmospheric phenomena.

• Surya is the Vedic deity associated with the Sun.

• Vayu is associated with wind.

• The Rigveda is divided into ten Mandalas.

• Mandala IX is known as the Soma Mandala.

questions.question:
With reference to the service rules in table tennis, consider the following statements:

I. In doubles play, the ball must successively touch the right half-court of the server and the receiver.

II. In singles play, the service must strictly travel diagonally across the center line of the table.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
टेबल टेनिस में सर्विस नियमों के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

I. युगल खेल में, गेंद को क्रमिक रूप से सर्वर और रिसीवर के दाएं आधे-कोर्ट को छूना चाहिए।

II. एकल खेल में, सर्विस को सख्ती से टेबल की केंद्र रेखा के पार तिरछे यात्रा करनी चाहिए।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II

questions.solution:
Statement I is correct:

In doubles, a legal service must first touch the server's right half-court and then the receiver's right half-court.

Thus, the service in doubles follows a diagonal pattern across the table.

This requirement is specifically prescribed under the table tennis service rules.

Statement II is incorrect:

In singles, there is no rule requiring the service to travel diagonally across the centre line.

The ball only needs to touch the server's court first and then the receiver's court in accordance with the service rules.

Therefore, a singles serve may be directed to different parts of the receiver's court.

Further Insights:

- A legal service begins with the ball resting freely on the open palm of the server's stationary free hand.

- The ball must be projected near vertically upwards and rise at least 16 cm during service.

- The ball must not be hidden from the receiver during service.

- In doubles, the order of serving and receiving follows a fixed sequence between the two pairs.

- In the deciding game of a doubles match, the receiving pair changes its receiving order when one pair first scores five points.

questions.question_hi:
