questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Fundamental Duties in India:

1) They are listed in Part IV-A of the Constitution under Article 51A.

2) They were added by the 42nd Amendment on the recommendation of the Swaran Singh Committee.

3) Originally, the Constitution contained 11 Fundamental Duties.

4) The duty of a parent or guardian to provide educational opportunities to a child aged 6 - 14 years was added by the 86th Amendment.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारत में मौलिक कर्तव्यों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) वे संविधान के भाग IV-A में अनुच्छेद 51A के तहत सूचीबद्ध हैं।

2) उन्हें स्वर्ण सिंह समिति की सिफारिश पर 42वें संशोधन द्वारा जोड़ा गया था।

3) मूल रूप से, संविधान में 11 मौलिक कर्तव्य थे।

4) 6-14 वर्ष की आयु के बच्चे को शैक्षिक अवसर प्रदान करने के लिए माता-पिता या अभिभावक का कर्तव्य 86वें संशोधन द्वारा जोड़ा गया था।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन से सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct. Part IV-A has one article, Article 51A.

Statement 2 is correct. The 42nd Amendment (1976) added them on the Swaran Singh Committee's recommendation.

Statement 3 is incorrect. There were originally 10 duties.

Statement 4 is correct. The 86th Amendment (2002) added the 11th duty.

Hence, statements 1, 2 and 4 only are correct, so (c) is the answer.

Further insights:

Fundamental Duties are non-justiciable. The idea was borrowed from the erstwhile USSR constitution.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the administration and economy of the Vijayanagara Empire:

1) The Nayankara system formed the core of the military administration, where military chiefs (Nayakas) were granted territorial tracts called amaram in exchange for maintaining armed contingents and paying tribute.

2) Under the Vijayanagara rulers, foreign trade was strictly prohibited along the Malabar and Coromandel coasts to preserve domestic agricultural wealth.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
विजयनगर साम्राज्य के प्रशासन और अर्थव्यवस्था के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) नायंकर प्रणाली सैन्य प्रशासन का मूल थी, जहाँ सैन्य प्रमुखों (नायकों) को सशस्त्र टुकड़ियों को बनाए रखने और श्रद्धांजलि देने के बदले में अमरम नामक क्षेत्रीय भूभाग प्रदान किए जाते थे।

2) विजयनगर शासकों के अधीन, घरेलू कृषि धन को संरक्षित करने के लिए मालाबार और कोरोमंडल तटों पर विदेशी व्यापार पर सख्ती से प्रतिबंध लगा दिया गया था।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: The Nayankara system was a unique administrative and military feature of Vijayanagara. Nayakas held revenues from assigned lands (amaram) to maintain fixed military forces and render annual tribute to the king.

Statement 2 is incorrect: Maritime trade flourished under Vijayanagara rule across major ports like Calicut, Cannanore, Mangalore, and Pulicat. The empire actively engaged in overseas trade with Arab countries, Persia, Portugal, and East Asia, importing items like warhorses, copper, and silk while exporting spices and textiles.

questions.question: Which of the following comprehensive statements regarding the Galvanizing Organic Bio-Agro Resources Dhan (GOBARdhan) initiative is correct?
questions.question_hi: गैल्वनाइजिंग ऑर्गेनिक बायो-एग्रो रिसोर्सेज धन (GOBARdhan) पहल के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा व्यापक कथन सही है?

options.label: A
options.text: It integrates bioenergy schemes to convert organic waste into compressed biogas and manure.
options.text_hi: यह जैविक कचरे को संपीड़ित बायोगैस और खाद में परिवर्तित करने के लिए जैव ऊर्जा योजनाओं को एकीकृत करता है।

options.label: B
options.text: It is a transit scheme running electric-hybrid buses on green hydrogen from wastewater.
options.text_hi: यह अपशिष्ट जल से हरित हाइड्रोजन पर इलेक्ट्रिक-हाइब्रिड बसें चलाने वाली एक पारगमन योजना है।

options.label: C
options.text: It enforces a total national ban on chemical nitrogenous fertilizers by year 2025.
options.text_hi: यह वर्ष 2025 तक रासायनिक नाइट्रोजनयुक्त उर्वरकों पर पूर्ण राष्ट्रीय प्रतिबंध लागू करता है।

options.label: D
options.text: It provides funding solely to urban households for private rooftop domestic biogas digesters.
options.text_hi: यह निजी रूफटॉप घरेलू बायोगैस डाइजेस्टर के लिए केवल शहरी परिवारों को धन प्रदान करता है।

questions.correct_text: It integrates bioenergy schemes to convert organic waste into compressed biogas and manure.
questions.solution:
Option (a) is correct: GOBARdhan is an umbrella initiative coordinating various government schemes and programmes that promote the conversion of organic waste into biogas, CBG/Bio-CNG and organic manure.

Option (b) is incorrect: The scheme focuses on converting organic waste and cattle dung into CBG and bio-slurry, not on running green hydrogen electric buses for transit.

Option (c) is incorrect: GOBARdhan encourages organic farming and bio-slurry adoption, but does not enforce a complete national ban on chemical fertilizers.

Option (d) is incorrect: The initiative targets commercial, community, and cluster-level biogas projects in rural and agricultural sectors, rather than individual urban rooftop units.

Further insights:

Unified Registration Portal: The government introduced the GOBARdhan Unified Registration Portal to streamline approvals and facilitate investment for CBG/biogas plant developers across the country.

Resource Recovery: Beyond bioenergy production, the fermented organic manure produced as a byproduct helps enrich soil organic carbon and reduces environmental pollution from open waste dumping.

questions.question: Which anatomical structure within the human respiratory system serves as the primary site of gaseous exchange?
questions.question_hi: मानव श्वसन प्रणाली के भीतर कौन सी शारीरिक संरचना गैसीय विनिमय के प्राथमिक स्थल के रूप में कार्य करती है?
questions.solution:
The alveoli are tiny, balloon-like structures located at the ends of the respiratory passages in the lungs.

They provide a large surface where the exchange of oxygen and carbon dioxide takes place.

Their thin walls are surrounded by an extensive network of blood vessels, allowing efficient diffusion of gases.

Further insights:

- The singular form of alveoli is alveolus.

- Haemoglobin in red blood cells transports most of the oxygen in blood.

- Carbon dioxide is transported from tissues towards the lungs for removal.

- The diaphragm plays an important role in the process of breathing.

- Bronchi divide into progressively smaller air passages called bronchioles.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the drainage systems in India:

1) Himalayan rivers generally originate from glaciers and snowcapped peaks, maintaining perennial flows year-round.

2) Peninsular rivers flow through broad and shallow valleys with gentle slopes and carry relatively lower sediment loads compared to Himalayan rivers.

3) Himalayan rivers typically display rectangular or radial drainage patterns, whereas Peninsular rivers strictly exhibit dendritic patterns.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारत में जल निकासी प्रणालियों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) हिमालयी नदियाँ आम तौर पर हिमनदों और बर्फ से ढकी चोटियों से निकलती हैं, जो साल भर बारहमासी प्रवाह बनाए रखती हैं।

2) प्रायद्वीपीय नदियाँ चौड़ी और उथली घाटियों से होकर बहती हैं जिनकी ढलान हल्की होती है और हिमालयी नदियों की तुलना में अपेक्षाकृत कम तलछट भार वहन करती हैं।

3) हिमालयी नदियाँ आम तौर पर आयताकार या अरीय जल निकासी पैटर्न प्रदर्शित करती हैं, जबकि प्रायद्वीपीय नदियाँ सख्ती से वृक्षाकार पैटर्न प्रदर्शित करती हैं।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Himalayan rivers originate from high glaciers and flow continuously with high silt loads through deep V-shaped valleys, whereas Peninsular rivers are seasonal, flow through broad and shallow valleys, and carry lower sediment loads.

Statement 3 is incorrect because drainage patterns are controlled by factors such as geological structure and slope and cannot be classified as strictly dendritic for Peninsular rivers or exclusively rectangular/radial for Himalayan rivers.

Further Insights:

The Peninsular river system is geologically older than the Himalayan river system, leading to mature river profiles with reduced erosion capacity.

questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस मेनू को 'ड्रॉप-डाउन मेनू' भी कहा जाता है?
questions.solution: A Pull-down menu is also called a drop-down menu. It's a common user interface element where a list of options is hidden until the user clicks on a button or tab. Once clicked, the list of options "drops down" for the user to select from.

questions.question: Which MIPS instruction is used to load a 32-bit immediate value into a register?
questions.question_hi: एक रजिस्टर में 32-बिट वाला तत्काल मान लोड करने के लिए किस MIPS निर्देश का उपयोग किया जाता है?
questions.solution: The LUI (Load Upper Immediate) instruction is used to load a 32-bit immediate value into the upper 16 bits of a register, with the lower 16 bits set to zero. This instruction is commonly used to load constants or addresses into a register. The ADDI (Add Immediate) instruction is used to add a 16-bit immediate value to a register. The LW (Load Word) instruction is used to load a 32-bit value from memory into a register. The OR instruction performs a bitwise OR operation between two registers. Therefore, LUI is the appropriate instruction for loading a 32-bit immediate value into a register.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements about charts in Microsoft Excel are correct?

1. A pie chart shows each category as a share of the whole.

2. A pie chart can plot several data series at the same time.

3. A sparkline is a miniature chart that fits inside a single cell.

4. A scatter (XY) chart requires text categories on its X-axis.
questions.question_hi:
माइक्रोसॉफ्ट एक्सेल में चार्ट के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-से कथन सही हैं?

1. पाई चार्ट (Pie Chart) प्रत्येक श्रेणी को संपूर्ण डेटा के एक हिस्से के रूप में दर्शाता है।

2. पाई चार्ट एक ही समय में कई डेटा सीरीज़ (Data Series) को प्रदर्शित कर सकता है।

3. स्पार्कलाइन (Sparkline) एक छोटा चार्ट होता है, जो एक ही सेल के अंदर समा जाता है।

4. स्कैटर (XY) चार्ट के लिए X-अक्ष पर टेक्स्ट श्रेणियों (Text Categories) का होना आवश्यक है।
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: Each slice represents the proportion of the total.

Statement 2 is incorrect: A pie chart can display only one data series.

Statement 3 is correct: Sparklines show trends within a cell and are available as line, column and win/loss.

Statement 4 is incorrect: A scatter chart plots numeric values on both axes.

Hence, option 2 (1 and 3 only) is the correct answer.

Further Insights:

Line charts are best for trends over time, column and bar charts for comparing categories and histograms for the frequency distribution of numeric data.

questions.question: Which of the following function key is used to search any feature in that application?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस फ़ंक्शन की (key) का उपयोग किसी एप्लिकेशन में किसी सुविधा को खोजने के लिए किया जाता है?
questions.solution: F3 - Opens a search feature for an application that is active at the moment. F4 - Alt + F4 closes the active window. F5 - Allows you to refresh or reload the page or document window. F6 - Moves the cursor to the address bar in most Internet browsers.

questions.question: Cold Boot in a computer is also called as?
questions.question_hi: कंप्यूटर में कोल्ड बूट को ____भी कहा जाता है|
questions.solution:
Cold boot is also called as Hard Boot. Cold boot is often used in contrast to a warm boot, which refers to restarting a computer once it has been turned on. A cold boot is typically performed by pressing the power button on the computer.

Both a cold boot and warm boot clear the system RAM and perform the boot sequence from scratch. However, unlike a cold boot, a warm boot may not clear all system caches, which store temporary information.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about relational databases:

1. A primary key column can contain NULL values.

2. A table can have only one primary key.

3. SQL is a language used to create, query and manipulate relational databases.

Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.question_hi:
रिलेशनल डेटाबेस (Relational Databases) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. प्राइमरी की (Primary Key) कॉलम में NULL मान हो सकते हैं।

2. एक टेबल (Table) में केवल एक प्राइमरी की हो सकती है।

3. SQL एक ऐसी भाषा है जिसका उपयोग रिलेशनल डेटाबेस को बनाने, क्वेरी करने और उसमें डेटा में बदलाव करने के लिए किया जाता है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन-से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is incorrect: A primary key must be unique and cannot contain NULL values.

Statement 2 is correct: A table has a single primary key, though it may be composite (made of more than one column).

Statement 3 is correct: SQL (Structured Query Language) is the standard language for relational databases.

Hence, option 2 (2 and 3 only) is the correct answer.

Further Insights:

A table can have several candidate keys but only one of them is chosen as the primary key; the rest are alternate keys.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about operating systems:

1. Linux is an open-source operating system.

2. Windows is a Graphical User Interface (GUI) based operating system.

3. The kernel is the core component of an operating system.

4. The BIOS is loaded from the hard disk into RAM during the boot process.

Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.question_hi:
ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. लिनक्स (Linux) एक ओपन-सोर्स ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम है।

2. विंडोज (Windows), ग्राफिकल यूजर इंटरफेस (GUI) पर आधारित ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम है।

3. कर्नेल (Kernel), ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम का मुख्य घटक होता है।

4. बूट प्रक्रिया (Boot Process) के दौरान BIOS को हार्ड डिस्क से RAM में लोड किया जाता है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन-से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: Its source code is freely available to use, study and modify.

Statement 2 is correct: Users interact with it through windows, icons and menus.

Statement 3 is correct: It manages memory, processes, devices and system calls.

Statement 4 is incorrect: The BIOS/UEFI firmware is stored on a chip on the motherboard (ROM/flash), not on the hard disk.

Hence, option 1 (1, 2 and 3 only) is the correct answer.

Further Insights:

Boot sequence: power on, firmware runs POST, the bootloader is located on the boot device and then loads the OS kernel into RAM.

questions.question: The process of entering data and instructions to a computer is called ___
questions.question_hi: कंप्यूटर में डेटा और निर्देश दर्ज करने की प्रक्रिया को ____________ कहा जाता है।
questions.solution:
· The process of entering data and instructions to a computer is called inputting.

· A computer is a system of organized machinery that accepts the data fed into it in the form of input.

· Further, it processes the useful information and gives the result which is called output.

· It also helps in storing the data in the secondary storage device for later use/reuse and safekeeping.

· This processing of input and output is performed by the hardware installed in the computer.

questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन डिजिटल पोर्ट का उदाहरण है?
questions.solution:

• PS/2 port

• VGA port

• Modem port

• FireWire Port

• Infrared Port

questions.question:
Which of the following statements about cloud computing are correct?

1. A public cloud shares its infrastructure among multiple organisations.

2. A private cloud is dedicated to a single organisation.

3. A hybrid cloud combines public and private clouds.
questions.question_hi:
क्लाउड कंप्यूटिंग के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-से कथन सही हैं?

1. पब्लिक क्लाउड (Public Cloud) अपने इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर को कई संगठनों के बीच साझा करता है।

2. प्राइवेट क्लाउड (Private Cloud) केवल एक संगठन के लिए समर्पित होता है।

3. हाइब्रिड क्लाउड (Hybrid Cloud), पब्लिक और प्राइवेट क्लाउड का संयोजन होता है।
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: Resources are owned by a provider and delivered over the internet to many customers.

Statement 2 is correct: It may be hosted on-premises or by a third party.

Statement 3 is correct: Data and applications can move between the two environments.

Hence, option 3 (All of 1, 2 and 3) is the correct answer.

Further Insights:

A community cloud is shared by several organisations with common concerns, such as government departments.

questions.question: Which of the following devices operates at the Physical layer of the OSI model?
questions.question_hi: OSI मॉडल की फिजिकल लेयर (Physical Layer) पर निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा डिवाइस कार्य करता है?
questions.solution:
Option 1 (Incorrect): Router - A router operates at the Network layer using IP addresses.

Option 2 (Incorrect): Switch - A switch normally operates at the Data Link layer using MAC addresses.

Option 3 (Incorrect): Bridge - A bridge operates at the Data Link layer and filters frames using MAC addresses.

Option 4 (Correct): Hub - A hub simply repeats electrical signals to all ports without reading any addresses, so it works at the Physical layer.

Hence, option 4 (Hub) is the correct answer.

Further Insights:

A repeater is also a Physical layer device. A hub is effectively a multiport repeater and creates a single collision domain.

questions.question: Whenever the computer is started or a software application is launched, the required program and data are loaded into ___________.
questions.question_hi: जब भी कंप्यूटर चालू (स्टार्ट) होता है या कोई सॉफ्टवेयर एप्लिकेशन लॉन्च होता है, तो आवश्यक प्रोग्राम और डेटा ___________ में लोड किया जाता है।

questions.question: Which part of CPU reads and interprets (decodes) the program instructions and transform them into control signals?

questions.solution:

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about network security:

1. A firewall can only be implemented as a hardware device and cannot be a software program.

2. A VPN creates an encrypted tunnel between a device and a network over the internet.

3. A proxy server acts as an intermediary between a client and the internet.

4. An Intrusion Prevention System can actively block detected threats.

Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.question_hi:
नेटवर्क सुरक्षा के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. फ़ायरवॉल (Firewall) को केवल हार्डवेयर डिवाइस के रूप में ही लागू किया जा सकता है और यह एक सॉफ्टवेयर प्रोग्राम नहीं हो सकता है।

2. VPN इंटरनेट के माध्यम से किसी डिवाइस और नेटवर्क के बीच एक एन्क्रिप्टेड टनल (Encrypted Tunnel) बनाता है।

3. प्रॉक्सी सर्वर (Proxy Server), क्लाइंट और इंटरनेट के बीच एक मध्यस्थ (Intermediary) के रूप में कार्य करता है।

4. इंट्रूज़न प्रिवेंशन सिस्टम (Intrusion Prevention System) पहचाने गए खतरों को सक्रिय रूप से रोक सकता है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन-से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is incorrect: Firewalls can be hardware, software or a combination of both.

Statement 2 is correct: This protects data from being read on public networks.

Statement 3 is correct: Requests from clients pass through the proxy, which can filter or cache content.

Statement 4 is correct: An IPS sits in the traffic path and blocks malicious traffic, whereas an IDS only detects and alerts.

Hence, option 1 (2, 3 and 4 only) is the correct answer.

Further Insights:

IDS stands for Intrusion Detection System. It monitors and raises alerts but does not by itself block traffic.

questions.question: Which of the following is a commonly used web search operator for exact phrase matching?
questions.question_hi: सटीक फ्रेज मैचिंग के लिए निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा आमतौर पर इस्तेमाल किया जाने वाला वेब सर्च ऑपरेटर है?
questions.solution: The commonly used web search operator for exact phrase matching is enclosing the phrase in quotation marks, like "search term." This tells the search engine to look for the exact phrase within the quotation marks rather than treating the words individually. This is useful when you want to find web pages or documents that contain an exact sequence of words in a specific order.

questions.question: By default, the title slide offers ______ text box/es in Microsoft PowerPoint.
questions.question_hi: डिफ़ॉल्ट रूप से माइक्रोसॉफ्ट पॉवरपॉइंट में शीर्षक/टाइटल स्लाइड ______ टेक्स्ट बॉक्स प्रदान करती है।
questions.solution: A title slide in PowerPoint is the first slide in the slide deck and appears in the PowerPoint workspace when that presentation is opened. By default, in PowerPoint, the title slide offers two text boxes for a title and subtitle. The title slide sets the pace for the ensuing presentation.

questions.question: Which technology ensures secure encrypted communication during online banking?
questions.question_hi: ऑनलाइन बैंकिंग के दौरान सुरक्षित एन्क्रिप्टेड संचार सुनिश्चित करने वाली तकनीक कौन सी है?
questions.solution:
HTTPS is the protocol that provides encrypted communication for sensitive activities like online banking.

Explanation:

· HTTPS (Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure) is the secure version of HTTP.

· It uses SSL/TLS encryption to protect the data being exchanged between the user's browser and the server, ensuring that hackers cannot "eavesdrop" on passwords or credit card numbers.

Further Insights:

· The "S" in HTTPS stands for Secure.

· Websites using HTTPS are verified by "Digital Certificates" issued by a Certificate Authority (CA).

questions.question_hi: माइक्रोसॉफ्ट के स्वामित्व वाले ईमेल एप्लिकेशन का नाम क्या है?

questions.question: Which MS Word feature allows users to track changes made by different reviewers in a document?

questions.solution: Track Changes is a collaboration tool that highlights every edit (additions, deletions, and formatting) in a different color, allowing the author to "Accept" or "Reject" them later.
